crossRefs.note: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt.…
Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe…
I, even I, have spoken. Yes, I have called him. I have brought him and he shall make his way prosperous.

translations.web: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”
translations.bsb: But he replied, “Do not delay me, since the LORD has made my journey a success. Send me on my way so that I may go to my master.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing Jehovah hath prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.
